messages:
matt: deploy-bot flagged release v2.14.0 canary -> holding deploy. SBOM provenance mismatch on package `libexpr` (origin: unknown). Also license alert for `parsilo` (ambiguous). Vulnerability scan shows transitive CVE-2025-1234 in subdep `parsilo:1.2.3`, score 7.2 (policy threshold 7.0). Do we pin/rollback or request exception? Need decision before 11:30 PST change window.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canaries paused by policy: reason=sbom_provenance_mismatch,vuln_threshold_exceeded. artifacts: sha256:abc123... See /releases/2187/sbom-report

jamie (security): I can triage. Initial thought: it might be pulled in via test-util or build tool. If it's dev-only we can document and proceed. Give me ~20m.

olivia (release): If it's runtime we should not push. If it's dev-only we can continue but flag in release notes and run a post-release patch sweep. Change window is tight; prefer rollback to last green if triage uncertain.

matt: quick container check: `grep -R "parsilo-1.2.3" /opt/app | head` returns `/opt/app/libs/parsilo-1.2.3.jar` — it's in the runtime layer.

jamie (security): ok runtime. Options: 1) pin to `parsilo:1.2.2` (no vuln) and rebuild artifact, 2) rollback to previous release, 3) emergency patch if available. Rebuild + QA will likely exceed window.

olivia (release): We don't have time for a full rebuild and E2E. Rollback seems fastest for availability. Any blockers to rollback @matt?

matt: rollback is trivial: revert the merge commit and trigger canary redeploy. I'll prepare the revert PR and tag for rollback.

sre-oncall: note: rollback will affect canary cohort B only; full prod rollout remains gated until canary passes. Set safe-traffic-limit=30% and watch latency/errors.

legal: also flagging license ambiguity — if we roll forward later, legal needs artifact provenance + license clarity. Create compliance ticket.

jamie (security): decision: rollback for now. I'll open a follow-up ticket to triage `parsilo` provenance and coordinate a pinned rebuild + license clearance. Assigning to jamie, matt, olivia.

matt: created revert PR #3428 and triggered deploybot rollback. Deploybot will post status updates.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollback triggered by matt. target=canary,revert=3428 -> 2 nodes -> status=running

olivia (release): update: marking v2.14.0 "held - security" in releases board and adding note to release notes: https://issues/redwood/SECU-6789

jamie (security): scheduling deep provenance audit and pinned rebuild in next change window (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). Follow-up ticket SECU-6790. Closing thread for decision. :white_check_mark:
